method: UTF-8 bytes / 4, rounded up: token proxy, not DeepSeek billing tokens

dashboard.prompt: Create a shipment insight report in dashboard format for delivered shipments. Keep it short and add graphs.

financial.prompt: Generate a Shipment Financial Analysis Report. Compare courier shipping charges and COD, Prepaid and ToPay. Include tables, graphs, findings and recommendations.

detailed.prompt: Create a detailed shipment report covering status, courier performance, cancellations and payment modes with tables and charts.

table_only.prompt: Show only a courier comparison table.

graphs_only.prompt: Show only graphs of shipment status.

live_dashboard.scope: one synthetic dashboard request, same source records and user prompt; all attempts included
